description: Execute an ordered array of canonical actions (and/or read tools) in a single atomic round-trip without autonomous_edit. Automatically runs safe-zone checks, timeline reconciliation, layout de-stacking, async asset completion, and commits the updated scene to project_id.

actions.description: Ordered list of { action, params } steps to execute.

assets.description: Optional media assets to seed a new project.

include_scene.description: If true, include the full raw scene JSON in the response (omitted by default in favor of liveLayers).

project_id.description: Project id for state persistence across calls.

video_url.description: Optional source video URL to seed a new project.

name: execute_batch
title: Execute canonical action batch
